findings.adjudication: The original sentence is not an explicit exhaustive stroke decomposition, but the omitted vertical is a useful localized clarification. Verified against the actual pinned SVG, not reviewer knowledge alone.
findings.evidence: KanjiVG 07a32.svg at 70a0b7ae0c18ceb5cb358274b029cce0234a43bc: g6 element 旧 contains left 丨 in g7 (stroke 10) and right 日 in g8 (strokes 11-14). SVG SHA-256 f59928ed72095b2484a04046a74a50454b4a319511b56a58aefbfc4af7bc1a98; preserved source matches the batch stroke audit.
findings.action: Mnemonic now says 旧 (a vertical stroke to the left of 日). It remains a modern-shape mnemonic, with no history/phonetic assertion or geometry change.
findings.confirmation: Both original sessions confirmed corrected teaching at 0a5f2e2; no regression.
